sky.heading: Twenty-five years of hallway conversations that became careers.
sky.subline: · and one very competitive side quest ·
sky.card-1-body: Kernel hackers to design engineers — three stages, zero filler, beginner to deep-cut.
sky.card-2-body: 30+ companies, on-site interviews and a résumé book that gets read before you land home.
sky.card-3-body: Trivia, karaoke, 2 AM demos — the part everyone says they came for "the talks".

dawn.about-body: Founded in 2002 and run by students ever since — three January days of unique and diverse tech experiences in downtown Montréal.
dawn.about-tag-1-body: from world-renowned experts on stage and in workshops
dawn.about-tag-2-body: with like-minded peers from across Canada
dawn.who-title: Everyone from first-years to Head Delegates.
dawn.who-body: High school, undergraduate and graduate students from all across Canada are welcome — most arrive as school delegations led by a Head Delegate (McGill, Waterloo, Seneca and 30+ more), but plenty come solo and leave with a crew.
dawn.know-1: Downtown Montréal hotel venue — discounted room block for delegates
dawn.know-2: Refreshments on site · Montréal's food scene outside the doors
dawn.know-3: Steps from the métro — fly, train or carpool in

hunt.title: The city is the game board.
hunt.body: Forty clues hidden in talks, the venue, and the streets of Montréal — those pins aren't decoration. Teams of four, a live leaderboard, and a $2,000 prize wall at closing ceremonies.

sponsors.heading: Backed by the best
sponsors.caption: 30+ companies join us every year · hover a hex to flip it, click to visit — your logo fits right here

faq.heading: Questions, answered
faq.a1: Any post-secondary student — plus grads & pros. Curiosity is the only prerequisite.
faq.a2: Every talk and workshop, the career fair, all three socials, a swag kit, and refreshments on site. Travel and lodging are on you.
faq.q3: Where do I stay in Montréal?
faq.a3: The venue is a downtown hotel and we hold a discounted room block for delegates. Booking details go out with your ticket confirmation.
faq.a4: Form a team of four, pick up your first clue at opening ceremonies, and chase forty clues across the venue and the city. The live leaderboard settles it at closing.
faq.a5: Full refunds until December 15. After that, tickets are transferable to another attendee — just email us.
